siteMap.note: Site map (permanent page index) — workspaces, landings and advisory edges. Detail (sections/organisms/bffCalls) lives per-workspace under workspaces/.

workspaces.title: Operational Dashboard
workspaces.purpose: Project manager gets a live overview of all active projects, budget health, and upcoming/overdue tasks.

workspaces.title: Project Detail & Timeline
workspaces.purpose: Project manager sets up, edits, and drives a single project through its full lifecycle — tasks, change orders, costs, and status reports — from one surface.

workspaces.title: Task Board
workspaces.purpose: Project manager reviews and updates the status of all work tasks across projects.

workspaces.title: My Tasks
workspaces.purpose: Field worker sees their assigned tasks, logs hours and materials, and marks tasks complete — all from a mobile-friendly surface.

workspaces.title: Client Directory
workspaces.purpose: Project manager maintains the client roster — browse, add, edit, and remove client records.

workspaces.title: Billing & Invoicing
workspaces.purpose: Billing staff reviews job costs, compiles billing summaries, generates invoices, and sends them to clients.

workspaces.title: Client Portal
workspaces.purpose: Client reviews shared project status reports, billing summaries, and invoices in a read-only self-serve view.

landings.reason: Project manager starts each day with the operational dashboard to check project health, budget drift, and task urgency.
Field worker opens the app directly to their assigned task list to see what to work on today.
Billing staff starts in the billing workspace to review job costs and manage summaries and invoices.
Client lands on the portal to view shared status reports and billing documents.

navigationEdges.description: Project manager drills into a specific project from the dashboard or project list.
Project manager navigates to the full task board from the dashboard task panel.
Project manager opens the client directory to create or select a client while setting up a project.
Billing staff accesses job cost summary from a project context to begin billing preparation.
Project manager publishes a status report, making it visible to the client in the portal.
Billing staff shares a billing summary, making it available to the client in the portal.
Billing staff sends an invoice, making it visible to the client in the portal.
Field worker taps a task in the list to open its detail and log time, materials, or update status.
